svg.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash High on corpus v3: verdicts
svg.desc: Every verdict of two trials on 64 held-out cases; sound plans Clean 61 of 63, defect twins Blockers 32 of 32, evidence-gap twins Changes 32 of 32.
svg.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash High on held-out corpus v3: every verdict
Route flash-high (native agy), model gemini-3.8-flash-high (requested, not attested); 64 cases, 2 trials, 1 runtime stop.
Sound plans judged Clean 61/63; defect twins Blockers 32/32; evidence-gap twins Changes 32/32.
Defect families (the twin breaks a stated rule)
Evidence-gap families (one decisive fact is not established)
Right verdict: Clean for a sound plan, Blockers for a defect twin, Changes for an evidence-gap twin.
Twins right in 64 of 64 observations. Sound plans hedged, never Blockers: Storage access (trial 2), Unique constraint (trial 2).
Dashed cell: runtime stop (error step, no report), Unique constraint sound plan, trial 1; not rerun, in no denominator.
Pairs discriminated, strict: 31/31 and 30/32. Zero unsupported VERIFIED findings.
11 reports used the label S01:n as the line number (read as that line, preregistered).
One reviewer, one route, one corpus written by Claude; a ceiling result is not a general accuracy rate.
